report.next_revision_failed: Retain the failure; the attempt is spent. Another image requires a specific new revision request.
report.cancelled: Cancelled by a newer human decision
report.draft_note: Some cases await actual human feedback. This internal inspection draft is not a final report and contains no final assets or package.
report.final_note: Actual human decisions have been recorded for the candidate pools. This report combines their feedback, internal findings and Codex disposition.
report.next_awaiting_report: Complete human review of remaining cases before the final report.
report.next_user_declined: Retain feedback and stop this batch without packaging.
report.title: Character image delivery report
report.source_restart: Restart from source (failed candidate is review evidence only)
report.next_redraw: Correct recorded failures within the remaining rounds and reassess all five dimensions and domain checks before human review.
report.next_exhausted_human: Stop generation, explain unresolved checks and failed calls, then present anonymous human review. Failed candidates cannot be packaged as final artwork.
report.next_human_review: Present anonymous review and record the actual user decision before delivery.
report.next_exhausted: Stop generation. Change the editing strategy using these findings; further attempts require explicit authorization.
report.next_blocked: Resolve missing or changed files/evidence before relying on the recorded scores.
report.next_review: Complete this round’s quality and applicable fidelity review; no qualified final yet.
report.next_revise: Follow refine-status strategy and reference roles within the remaining authorized rounds, then review again.
report.next_failed: Retain the candidate and findings; obtain an explicit attempt budget for a further revision.
report.note: Scores and observations are from saved assistant/user reviews. This command validates records and gates, not visual quality. Passed images are ready for user review, not automatically accepted. Only listed projects and cases are covered.
report.scope_note: Recorded full-image, target, protected-detail, normal-display and edge inspection flags appear below. Display size follows the original assessment; this command does not add game integration testing.
report.canvas_note: Different dimensions do not block acceptance, selection, or PNG/ZIP export. Check each image’s actual dimensions; files are copied unchanged, without automatic resizing or alignment. Preview scaling is for display only.
report.snapshot: This report is a snapshot. Regenerate after subsequent file/project changes. Process images are not acceptance criteria.
report.summary: Cases: {cases}; passed: {passed}; not delivered: {other}; candidates within scope: {images}.
report.canvas_warning: Canvas differs from source: export is allowed; files keep their actual dimensions without resizing.
report.quality_stale: Prompt/comparison evidence changed; recorded scores cannot establish current passage.
report.gate_note: Meeting the total threshold alone does not pass: each dimension, all domain checks, current review evidence and applicable fidelity/file gates must also pass. Minor brushwork variation is acceptable; identity or structural changes still require correction.
report.next_revision_request: Handle the actual revision request; this report does not authorize additional generation.
report.CANVAS_MISMATCH: Canvas differs from source (export allowed; no resizing)
